g.text: Where each piece of data the optional AI analyst sees comes from, what is done to it before the model, and where the model's output ends up.
Nothing the model writes changes a record until a person accepts it, and every run keeps a record that ties its answer and proposals to their inputs.
Shown: Momus working tree of 2026-11-26 | brain base python:3.13-slim@sha256:7249d5587b78 | anthropic 2.14.0, openai 3.59.0, google-genai 3.6.1, boto3 1.44.11 | Jinja2 3.1.6
Brain container: the analyst inside the web application
1 Scanned-site text: tool output, minimized and redacted
2 Snapshot copied, hash-checked, read by the tools
3 Version-watch results, read through the checker
4 The admin's question, redacted before it is sent
5 Accepted notes go into later runs
6 Settings confirmed by an admin before any run
7 Each step's prompt, with the key, to the provider
8 The model's answer, checked by the validator
9 Every step and the outcome written to the record
10 Pages to the browser as escaped plain text
11 A person accepts or rejects one proposal
